works.title: Political Novel Series (15 novels)
works.description: An ambitious series of 15 interconnected political novels under active development. The user reports having an efficient AI-assisted writing system in place and a concrete timeline to complete the entire series within six weeks. Focuses on political themes and dynamics.
works.quote: I'm writing a series of 15 novels mostly about politics, and I'm deeply into it. I'm going to complete all of them over the next six weeks because I have a system for writing through AI that is tremendous and works well.

works.title: Erotic/Romance Novel Series
works.description: A dormant erotic and romance novel series being reactivated through current romantic inspiration. Initial development includes character psychology research (INFP archetypes, polarity dynamics, Devoted Muse framework) and narrative craft planning using a real person (Samantha) as a muse and character inspiration.
